name: mcpjam
description: Inspect MCP servers and review evaluations in your MCPJam projects.

interface.longDescription: Connect your MCPJam account to inspect saved MCP servers, manage evaluations, and review test results from ChatGPT and Codex. Included skills guide evaluation runs, Playground debugging, test imports, SDK test authoring, and interpretation of evaluation results. Access is limited to projects available to your connected account. Some operations modify project data or consume MCPJam credits. SDK and CLI workflows require a local development environment.
defaultPrompt: Show the MCP servers in my project.

positive.prompt: Which MCPJam account am I connected to?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the connected reviewer account; do not invent account details.
List only projects accessible to review@mcpjam.com, including Default in MCPJam Review's Org. Select that organization; do not use another organization with a Default project.

positive.prompt: List the servers in my Default project.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the seeded project and list its saved sample servers without exposing credentials.

positive.prompt: Show the test cases in the Excalidraw quickstart suite in my Default project.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the seeded suite and summarize its saved cases without launching a paid run.

positive.prompt: Summarize the latest completed run of Excalidraw quickstart in my Default project.
positive.expected_behavior: Report the completed 1/1 passing run, distinguishing tool assertions and advisory judge results from the scorecard Outcome achieved: Not measured. Do not start a new run.

negative.prompt: Show private projects belonging to an organization I cannot access.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not reveal inaccessible data or attempt to bypass access controls; explain the access limitation.

negative.prompt: Print the raw API keys stored in my project secrets.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not expose raw credentials; explain that secret tools return metadata only.

negative.prompt: Tell me which eval suites exist, but do not run, edit, or delete anything.
negative.expected_behavior: Use read-only discovery tools only; do not launch runs, incur model charges, or mutate suites.

publication.release_notes: First marketplace submission. Version 1.0.1 corrects reviewer fixture names; includes the hosted MCPJam connection and six skills for evaluations and debugging.
